webhooks.detail: Webhooks API: create/list/delete/toggle webhooks, ping to notification URL, list payloads, refresh. Webhooks from PAT/OAuth expire after 7 days unless refreshed.

evidence.quote: Webhooks are a user-configurable way to get programmatic notifications when data is changed in an Airtable base.

sandbox.detail: Free plan account usable for testing; PATs available on all plans; free plan capped at ~1,000 API calls per workspace per month (from Airtable support article, not verbatim-quoted). No separate sandbox product found.

evidence.quote: Personal access tokens are used to authenticate requests to Airtable's API.

rate_limits.summary: 5 req/s per base; 50 req/s per user/service account across PATs; 429 then wait 30s

evidence.quote: The API is limited to 5 requests per second per base.
The Airtable API can be used to integrate your data in Airtable with any external system.
